verdict.rationale: Composio's agent plugins let Codex or Claude Code operate Composio from the current conversation, and the docs say the user need not know a tool slug or connection ID because 'the agent searches by task and selects a matching tool' (composio-docs-25, composio-docs-30). The Composio Connect MCP server and the quickstart flow ('tell the agent to continue') extend the same natural-language operation to connecting accounts and executing actions (composio-docs-26, composio-docs-27). The CLI covers connecting apps, executing tools and debugging projects for coding agents (composio-docs-10). Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface (operation depends on an external agent such as Codex or Claude Code), natural-language coverage of project and admin configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversational flow.
